simple.summary: שָׁפָה (shâphâh) means to abrade , i.e. bare First listed occurrence: Isa 13 2.

definitions.full: H8192. shaphah I. [ שָׁפָה ] verb sweep bare (Arabic (), of wind, raise and carry off dust, of horse, scanty in hair of forelock; Late Hebrew Pi`el plane off ; Aramaic Passive participle level ( Isa 40:4 = מִישׁוֺר ), smooth, limpid , make level, smooth (and derivatives)); — Niph`al be wind-swept, bare; Participle הַרנִֿשְׁמֶּה Isa 13:2 a bare mountain ; Pu`al Perfect consecutive עַצְמֹתָיו וְשֻׁפוּ Job 33:21 Qr his bones are laid bare (so lean is he; Kt וּשְׁפִי bareness are his bones).
